description.describe_ch: 深化創新與創業評估的理解和技能，包含創新思維、策略發展、商業模型、數位轉型等實務評估。透過實案分析，將知識應用於實際商業情境，培養創業精神和創新能力。探索各種創新策略，學習如何評估其可行性和成功潛力。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to enhance the understanding and skills in innovation and entrepreneurial evaluation, encompassing areas like innovative thinking, strategy development, business models, and digital transformation. It employs real-case analysis to apply theoretical insights into practical business scenarios, nurturing entrepreneurial and innovative capabilities. Students are immersed in an environment where they can explore various innovation strategies and learn to assess their viability and potential for success, ensuring a comprehensive grasp of modern entrepreneurial dynamics.

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生理解創新的定義、特性、種類與實務架構
targets.describe_en: Cultivate students' understanding of the definition, characteristics, types, and practical frameworks of innovation

targets.describe_ch: 訓練學生應用資訊科技進行創新創作
targets.describe_en: Train students to apply information technology for innovative creation

targets.describe_ch: 透過實務案例，分析創新產品、新創公司的成敗關鍵因素
targets.describe_en: Analyze the critical factors that contribute to the success or failure of innovative products and startup companies through practical case studies

targets.describe_ch: 引導學生結合課程訓練之綜合能力，實際針對真實世界問題，設計規劃解決方案，並評估創業的機會與成功潛力
targets.describe_en: Guide students to integrate the comprehensive skills acquired from the course, practically address real-world problems by designing and planning solutions, and evaluate the opportunities and potential for entrepreneurial success
